17FBS-017 Namespaced blueprint ids and scope:global ADR conflict surfacing cli AC10 deps1 medium notStarted

Blueprint-contributed docs are namespaced by the blueprint's slug: REQ/US/PRD/BS/TAD/TS via the 0.4.4 slug PREFIX (e.g. `spa-REQ-001`), and ADR/TAC/FBS/CN via the 0.4.3 kebab SUFFIX (e.g. `ADR-005-rest-versioning`). `rcf define blueprint add` runs a conflict-detection pass BEFORE writing anything: two blueprints both contributing an ADR tagged `scope: global` on the same topic exit non-zero with both sides printed and four honest resolution paths named (adopt-incoming, keep-existing, supersede via project ADR, declare-on-add via `--resolve`). Non-global TACs, ADRs, REQs, USs and FBSes namespace cleanly and cannot topic-conflict; cross-blueprint id claims (an incoming id already recorded on another applied blueprint) are refused via the authoritative manifest record, not string grammar.

Approach

Namespacing is enforced at the loader: contribution ids are stamped with the blueprint slug at load time; a contribution whose declared id already carries a namespace is trusted verbatim (author declaration is the truth for what that blueprint owns; the earlier grammar-veto of legitimate slug-tail ids like `ADR-201-spa-theme` under blueprint `spa` was retired in w-2026-08-19-005). Ownership of a written contribution is answered by the manifest's `appliedBlueprintRecord.contributions[]` list — the authoritative record — not by re-parsing the id string. Conflict detection reads the applied `blueprints[]` and the applying blueprint's contributions, and scores collisions along two axes: `scope: global` ADR topic collision (two applied ADRs both tagged `scope: global` with a matching `topic` field), and cross-blueprint ownership (an incoming id whose manifest record is on a DIFFERENT applied blueprint's contribution list — the class the record consultation catches once grammar stopped being a trust surface). Presentation: per-conflict block leads with both ADR titles and their one-sentence decisions, ids and paths as a footer, and four honest resolution paths with actual blueprint slugs filled in — no placeholders. A `--json` output shape is available for agent-driven composition. Phase 3.5 (w-2026-08-19-008) added the `supersede` and `diff` verbs plus the `--resolve` add-time flag, backed by `manifest.resolutions[]` on the 0.4.5 schema; both blueprint ADRs may now co-reside on disk as superseded history alongside a project-level ADR that supersedes them.

Acceptance criteria (10)

AC-1002-1, AC-1002-2, AC-1002-3, AC-1002-4, AC-1002-5, AC-1002-6, AC-1002-7, AC-1002-8, AC-1002-9, AC-1002-10

Depends on

  • FBS-016 Blueprint verb family (add, list, remove, upgrade) with manifest.blueprints[] writes

Deliverables

  • src/blueprint/namespace.js: pure functions that stamp/verify contribution namespacing for all doc kinds
  • src/blueprint/conflicts.js: detectGlobalAdrConflicts(appliedBlueprints, incomingContributions) returning zero-or-more Conflict records
  • Updates to src/blueprint/apply.js: conflict pass runs BEFORE any file write; non-empty conflict list short-circuits with a printed report + non-zero exit
  • test/blueprint/namespace.test.js: prefix/suffix stamping tests keyed to AC-1002-1
  • test/blueprint/conflicts.test.js: global-ADR conflict cases keyed to AC-1002-2 / AC-1002-3, non-conflict cases for AC-1002-4

18FBS-018 Standards ingestion: rcf define standards add + reference-by-default cli AC4 small buildable notStarted

Introduce a `rcf define standards <verb>` verb family (`add`, `list`) that registers standards packs on the project manifest. Reference-by-default when the source lives inside the project root; copy into `rcf/standards/<slug>/` only when the source lives outside. Manifest registration is authoritative; every add writes a `manifest.standards[]` entry per the 0.4.4 `standardsPackRecord` schema.

Approach

One dispatcher, one applier. src/cli/standards.js parses `add|list`; src/blueprint/standards.js resolves whether the source is inside or outside the project root (via node:path.relative + startsWith), copies when needed, and writes the manifest entry. Copy path is fs.cp recursive with a per-run overwrite guard (idempotent re-adds refuse to re-copy unless `--refresh` is passed; Phase 1 keeps to add-only + idempotent read, `refresh` verb deferred to Phase 3).

Acceptance criteria (4)

AC-1003-1, AC-1003-2, AC-1003-3, AC-1003-4

Deliverables

  • src/cli/standards.js: parseArgs + HELP + main() for add/list
  • src/blueprint/standards.js: registerStandardsPack(root, opts) — in-root vs out-of-root detection + optional copy + manifest.standards[] write
  • bin/rcf.js: `standards: standardsMain` on SUBCOMMANDS
  • src/cli/help.js: `standards <verb>` on the TOP_LEVEL block
  • test/blueprint/standards.test.js: in-root reference / out-of-root copy / idempotency cases keyed to AC-1003-1..4

19FBS-019 Selective retrieval at bundle assembly (contextRequirements.standardIds) build AC4 deps1 small notStarted

Extend `src/build/bundle.js#assembleBundle` so its `context` section reads `contextRequirements.standardIds`. When the FBS carries an operator-authored `standardIds` array, that array is honoured verbatim. Otherwise a deterministic tag-scoring selector reads the FBS work text (title + summary + approach + notes + AC descriptions) against `manifest.standards[]` (tags + slug + summary) and returns the subset of slugs whose tags occur in the work text. The bundle's context.standardIds carries the selection; the standards' summaries render into the standards payload alongside TACs and ADRs.

Approach

The selector is a pure function in src/build/standards-selector.js — no wall clock, no random source, no network. Scoring is deterministic tag-hit counting with lowercase-normalised substring match; ties break by manifest order (standards[] is authored). The bundle assembler prefers operator-authored `contextRequirements.standardIds` when present (design principle 5 override path) and calls the selector otherwise. Empty selection is legitimate and never blocks. Phase 1 keeps the selector local and heuristic; the design brief allows a small model call, but adding an LLM dependency to a pure projection is out of scope for the mechanism landing — the heuristic satisfies the ACs and the seam is where a smarter selector plugs in.

Acceptance criteria (4)

AC-1004-1, AC-1004-2, AC-1004-3, AC-1004-4

Depends on

  • FBS-018 Standards ingestion: rcf define standards add + reference-by-default

Deliverables

  • src/build/standards-selector.js: selectStandards(fbs, standards) — deterministic tag-hit scoring returning the ordered subset of slugs
  • src/build/bundle.js: contextRequirements.standardIds hosts operator override or selector output; standards payload rendered into context alongside tacs/adrs
  • test/build/standards-selector.test.js: deterministic-selection cases keyed to AC-1004-1, AC-1004-3, AC-1004-4
  • test/build/bundle-standards.test.js: bundle-shape cases (default + override) keyed to AC-1004-1, AC-1004-2

20FBS-020 Verify pins the Playwright MCP version verify AC4 small verified

23FBS-023 Init: Playwright MCP entry only when no scope-visible entry exists verify AC5 small verified

Add a --no-playwright-mcp flag. After the rcf mcp entry write, detect a project-scope Playwright signature (any args string matching /^@playwright/mcp(@|$)/) and leave it alone if present. Otherwise probe the harness (claude mcp list + claude mcp get <name>) and, on 'none' or 'inconclusive', write a distinctly named playwright-rcf project-scope entry. --no-playwright-mcp suppresses the write step entirely; the probe still runs so the print-out remains honest.

36FBS-036 Browser-verify runner extension: blueprint-shipped probe pack loader, scoping predicate, aggregate verdict and --probe-pack CLI AC8 buildable notStarted

T-0 of the ratified visual round (spec 2026-09-04, section 2.1): the browser-verify runner extension that lets a blueprint ship a Playwright probe pack under `blueprints/<slug>/probe-packs/` and have `rcf verify browser` discover, scope-check and run it as a required ship gate. Six ACs span the loader (schema + `.pack.js` and `.pack.mjs`), the applicability predicate (source-scan for one of the three legal scoping seams: route, tacIds or `blueprint:` tag), the check-id cross-check against the shipping blueprint's contributed AC ids, the runner pass (after invariants and auth-smoke, packs receive an injected browser and fetch), the aggregate verdict extension (block on any `severity: block` pack fail), the `--probe-pack <name>` CLI restriction, and the optional `preChecks[]` fast-fail slot with `dependsOn` skip semantics. Zero new npm dependencies; the pinned Playwright MCP the launcher provisions is the browser access seam. Unblocks T-1..T-5 (datatable, charts, dashboard, notifications-in-app, admin-console).

Acceptance criteria (8)

AC-1701-1, AC-1701-2, AC-1701-3, AC-1701-4, AC-1701-5, AC-1701-6, AC-1701-7, AC-1701-8

40FBS-040 application-notifications-in-app v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf: 19 contributions, Playwright probe pack with three anchored checks, sample-app fixture with four break switches, and the family-prefix reservation across the shelf registry AC6 buildable notStarted

T-4 of the ratified visual round (spec 2026-09-04, section 5.4): the application-notifications-in-app v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf. Ships 19 contributions (5 REQs on live-region preseeding, transient toast contract, notification centre inbox with acknowledge round-trip, per-user preferences UI with sibling delegation, and delivery-attempt log; 8 USs binding runtime-observable ACs plus three cross-cutting cases; 3 TACs on the live-region wrappers and toast factory, centre inbox and acknowledge round-trip, and preferences UI; 3 ADRs on the priority-to-role mapping polite/status vs assertive/alert per WCAG 4.1.3 and ARIA APG alert, the six-second toast timeout floor per WCAG 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable, and the thirty-day centre retention window), a Playwright probe pack whose three checks (AC-20101-1 live-region preseeded on every declared route, AC-20102-1 transient toast contract with priority-to-role mapping and timeout floor measured via data-shown-at/data-dismissed-at, AC-20103-1 centre acknowledge round-trip enumerated by data-notification-id with client + server request-log reconciliation) are anchored to blueprint AC ids per T-0 AC-1701-3 and each carries a description field per spec section 9 (with AC-20101-1 description carrying the word 'preseeded' per the T-4 row), and a dependency-free sample-app fixture the pack probes for real, with four break switches for the negative runs (preseed, role, timeout, ack). Reserves the family prefix application-notifications- for the sibling channels the shelf will grow into (email, push, webhook) as a doc-only reservation on the blueprint README and every applying blueprint's docs/topics.md registry row. Applies cleanly (validate 0, coverage strict 0, eval strict 0 on a scratch project).

41FBS-041 Capability-declaration mechanism and four shelf auth blueprint 1.1.0/1.2.0 minor bumps AC9 buildable notStarted

T-5 mechanism track of the ratified visual round (spec 2026-09-04, section 5.5). 44FBS-060 persistence-data-postgres v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf with six Node-only probes against a live postgres:17-alpine container and a sample-app fixture AC6 deps1 notStarted

T-1 shelf-blueprint track of the ratified infra round 5 spec (2026-09-06, section 5.1) re-minted with HQ reserved-block ids (REQ-040 / US-4001 / TS-070 / FBS-060 / CN-200..202) after HQ round-4 T-1 (application-empty-error-states) merged first to origin/main at 784d12f. Ships the persistence-data-postgres v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf with 26 contributions in the 7 REQ / 10 US 27101-27110 / 4 TAC 2801-2804 / 5 ADR 2801-2805 groups per spec section 5.1, six Node-only probes under blueprints/persistence-data-postgres/contributions/probes/ (facade-round-trip, migration-apply, prepared-statement-scan, transaction-atomicity, recovery-restore-round-trip, pool-posture-smoke) with matching run-<probe-name>.mjs shims writing per-blueprint reports at .rcf/reports/blueprints/persistence-data-postgres/<probe-name>.json, and a dependency-free sample-app fixture at packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/infra-postgres/ with docker-compose declaring postgres:17-alpine, three toy forward-only migrations, src/store.mjs realising the facade as sole reader of pg, src/migrate.mjs realising the migration runner (with SIMULATE_MIGRATION_FAILURE switch), src/recovery.mjs realising the scheduled export runner via pg_dump, package.json with pg as runtime dep, and a README naming docker and podman incantations plus induced-failure switches. Declares capabilities [relationalStore], suggestedCompanions logging and errorHandling, providesRoles absent, requiresAppliedCapabilities absent. Contributes ADR-2801 and ADR-2802 as scope:global on persistenceStore and migrationDiscipline reused from persistence-data-sqlite and persistence-data-d1 so composition with either surfaces a DELIBERATE conflict per the round-2 pattern. Extends packages/rcf-lite/docs/blueprint-authoring.md section 6a table with a relationalStore row per spec section 5.6; appends one shelf-registry row for persistence-data-postgres at 27101-27899 / 28xx to every shipped blueprint docs/topics.md. Reserves the round-6 Hyperdrive v1.1.0 adapter slot at ADR-2801 by keeping the driver reference opaque at the facade boundary per spec section 5.7. None of the six probes carry accountBound:true; Postgres is local-first per Baz decision 8.

Acceptance criteria (6)

AC-4001-1, AC-4001-2, AC-4001-3, AC-4001-4, AC-4001-5, AC-4001-6

Depends on

  • FBS-043 application-empty-error-states v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf with the eight-state probe pack and sample-app fixture

T-3 shelf-blueprint track of the ratified visual round 4 (spec 2026-09-06, section 5.3): the application-forms-wizard v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf. Ships 19 contributions (5 REQs on the task-list contract with the closed GOV.UK vocabulary Cannot start yet plus Not started plus In progress plus Completed with an ARIA progressbar wrapper, the per-step validation timing rule on-blur before first submit then on-change after first failure and a full pass on submit reusing SPA forms-engine TAC-205 per WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.1 and 3.3.3, the error-summary contract with a top-of-page summary and skip links per failed field with aria-invalid true on the field and aria-describedby to the per-field error message and focus moved to the summary heading on submit failure, the summary-review contract with a summary-list rendering per step with Change links returning to each step and every other answer retained on save per WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.4, the save-and-return contract with a server-side draft table or a client-side local buffer with a per-write ISO-8601 sync tick with the pack refusing to ship if neither is wired per WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.7; 8 USs 24101 to 24108 one per REQ plus three cross-cutting cases linear-vs-free navigation, in-progress list and no-in-progress empty state delegated to application-empty-error-states; 3 TACs 2501 task-list shell and 2502 error-summary contract and 2503 draft store; 3 ADRs 2501 navigation posture linear default with elicited free branch, 2502 save-and-return transport across server-draft-table and client-local-buffer elicited with NO recommendedDefault, 2503 step indicator across task-list ARIA progressbar and breadcrumb with recommendedDefault true on task-list), a Playwright probe pack whose four checks (AC-24101-1 task-list, AC-24103-1 error-summary, AC-24104-1 summary-review, AC-24105-1 save-and-return) each bind TAC-2501 or the operator-configured wizard-route glob with URLs composed by withUrl(runtimeUrl, path), and a dependency-free sample-app fixture at packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/probe-pack-application-forms-wizard/ realising the four wizard surfaces honestly on /task-list, /step/<n>, /summary and /in-progress plus both save-and-return transports server default and local elicited plus four break switches (?break=task-list-vocab, ?break=no-summary, ?break=no-retain, ?break=no-draft) driving the negative runs. suggestedCompanions logging and errorHandling; providesRoles absent; requiresAppliedCapabilities absent; capabilities absent. Eighth shipped consumer of T-0 probe-pack runner extension.

AC-2601-1, AC-2601-2, AC-2601-3, AC-2601-4, AC-2601-5, AC-2601-6, AC-2601-7

48FBS-046 application-account-settings v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf with 5-check probe pack, sample-app fixture, four auth-blueprint minor bumps, observability-logging minor and mechanism minor for Q3 refusal AC8 deps1 notStarted

T-4 shelf-blueprint track of the ratified visual round 4 spec (2026-09-06 section 5.4): the application-account-settings v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf with 24 contributions (6 REQs shell + profile + security + sessions + notifications + theme; 10 USs 25101 to 25110; 4 TACs 2601 shell / 2602 capability-discovery / 2603 hosted-ui-bridge / 2604 session-store; 4 ADRs 2601 capability-vocabulary extension / 2602 security-surface-shape elicited no default / 2603 theme-persistence spa-local-storage default / 2604 reauth-window 15m default). Declares requiresAppliedCapabilities principalDirectory with the application-account-settings-bare-spa refusal template and the allow-no-auth-yet override; 8 elicits (4 custom-auth-provides plus security-surface-shape hosted-identity-url theme-persistence reauth-window). Ships a Playwright probe pack with five capability-gated checks anchored to AC-25101-1 AC-25102-1 AC-25105-1 AC-25106-1 AC-25108-1, and a dependency-free sample-app fixture with the five conditional surfaces plus four break switches. Rides with the auth-blueprint minor bumps clerk 1.3.0 (adds sessionInventory hostedIdentityUi) keycloak 1.2.0 (adds credentialSelfService sessionInventory) oauth2 1.2.0 (adds credentialSelfService sessionInventory hostedIdentityUi provider-conditional) magic-link 1.2.0 (doc-only) and the observability-logging 1.2.0 minor bump (adds sessionInventory as the logging-projection provider). Extends the section 6a capability table in packages/rcf-lite/docs/blueprint-authoring.md with three new capability strings. Mechanism minor: buildRefusalMessage carries the application-account-settings-bare-spa template; runElicitationPhase refuses when an operator answers a gated elicit whose when predicate did not fire (Q3 refusal). Composes on application-empty-error-states T-1 for the forbidden and empty-history states; no bespoke access-denied UI. Ninth shipped consumer of T-0 probe-pack runner extension. suggestedCompanions logging and errorHandling; providesRoles absent; capabilities absent.

49FBS-047 application-onboarding-tour v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf with 4-check probe pack, dependency-free sample-app fixture composing on dashboard notifications-in-app account-settings SPA and Q4 fallback (spa-local-storage) when no persistence blueprint is applied AC8 deps1 notStarted

T-5 shelf-blueprint track of the ratified visual round 4 spec (2026-09-06 section 5.5): application-onboarding-tour v1.0.0 on the shelf with 17 contributions (4 REQs step-manifest + tooltip-as-dialog + checklist-slot + completion-state; 7 USs 26101 to 26107; 3 TACs 2701 step-runner / 2702 checklist-slot / 2703 completion-store; 3 ADRs 2701 dismissal-policy / 2702 completion-store-shape (Q4 default spa-local-storage) / 2703 checklist-anchor). No requiresAppliedCapabilities (composes on SPA, application-dashboard, application-notifications-in-app, application-account-settings and any auth without hard dependency; per Q4 the completion-state falls back to spa-local-storage when no persistence blueprint is applied). Ships a Playwright probe pack with four surface-observable checks anchored to AC-26101-1 AC-26102-1 AC-26103-1 AC-26104-1, and a dependency-free sample-app fixture with a three-to-five step tour, per-step tooltip-as-dialog per the ARIA APG dialog-modal pattern, a checklist slot switchable between dashboard-top and settings-page, a completion-state store switchable across the three shapes, and four break switches (no-role, focus-escape, no-collapse, no-persist). Composes on application-dashboard for the dashboard-top anchor (with settings-page fallback), application-notifications-in-app for the checklist-completion announcement, application-account-settings for the restart-tour control home, and application-spa for routing and iconography. Tenth shipped consumer of the T-0 probe-pack runner extension. suggestedCompanions logging and errorHandling; providesRoles absent; capabilities absent.

Ships the deploy-cloudflare-workers v1.2.0 additive-minor delta on the shipped v1.1.0 blueprint (seven new contributions in the existing 12xx US band and 13xx suffix: 2 REQs REQ-013 and REQ-014; 3 USs US-12113 US-12114 US-12115; 1 ADR ADR-1306 with the verbatim Cloudflare Pages landing-page quote and standardsTraceClause Cloudflare Pages landing-page recommendation (2026-09-06); 1 probe module assets-manifest-scan.mjs with anchorAcId AC-12113-1 and accountBound false; 2 new elicits assets-directory string default empty and run-worker-first boolean default false, both on top-level elicits[]). Ships the cf-platform shared sample-app fixture at packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/cf-platform/ (wrangler.toml with [assets] directory = ./dist and run_worker_first = true, dist/index.html, src/index.mjs Worker entry, package.json declaring wrangler devDependency and wrangler dev start, run-assets-manifest-scan.mjs shim, README with the two induced-failure switches SIMULATE_MIXED_SHAPE and SIMULATE_EMPTY_ASSETS documented). Adds one anatomy test file at packages/rcf-lite/test/blueprint/deploy-cloudflare-workers-v-1-2-0-anatomy.test.js covering the 8 TCs on TS-073 TS-074 TS-075 (blueprint shape, probe contract and scan-pass, chain-slice cross-check, elicits shape, fixture files, ADR body and clause, guide section and URLs, three-state probed verdicts). Updates the blueprint README.md with a v1.2.0 delta section, ships a new blueprint CHANGELOG.md with the v1.2.0 entry, adds the guide section titled Workers-with-static-assets: the SPA-on-Workers shape linking the Cloudflare migrate-from-Pages guide and citing the static-assets docs page, bumps the deploy-cloudflare-workers row on blueprints/deploy-cloudflare-workers/docs/topics.md and on blueprints/application-spa/docs/topics.md from shipped v1.0.0 to shipped v1.2.0. HQ round-7 follow-up: object-storage-s3 v1.1.0 minor bump adding the Hetzner Object Storage provider value under the shipped S3-API facade contract (blueprints/object-storage-s3/, was 1.0.0). Delta contributions on the blueprint side (target 4): one blueprint REQ object-storage-s3-REQ-101 (Hetzner endpoint-shape contract), one blueprint US object-storage-s3-US-28110 with AC-28110-1 (labelled AC-hetznerObjectStorage-endpointRoundTrip), one blueprint TAC TAC-2904-object-storage-s3-hetzner-endpoint-helper, one blueprint ADR ADR-2905-object-storage-s3-hetzner-object-storage-provider with standardsTraceClause 'Hetzner Object Storage S3 compatibility documented endpoint shape'. Every existing v1.0.0 contribution id byte-identical (no renumber, no reshape). Extends the shared fixture packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/infra-s3-and-queue/ (no second fixture directory) with src/hetzner-endpoint.mjs (composes <bucket>.<location>.your-objectstorage.com from an elicited bucket and location per Hetzner storage overview fsn1/hel1/nbg1 codes) plus a fixture-side shim run-hetzner-object-storage-round-trip.mjs. New Node-only probe blueprints/object-storage-s3/contributions/probes/hetzner-object-storage-round-trip.mjs (accountBound true, gated on CI_HAS_HETZNER_OBJECT_STORAGE, records accountBoundSkipped when unset per spec section 3.5); mutation SIMULATE_HETZNER_ENDPOINT_MISSHAPEN true (fixture-side INPUT-side mutation) composes an invalid endpoint via the fixture shim and the probe FAILS naming the missing subdomain. The round-5 T-2 shipped probes (facade-round-trip, put-get-round-trip, presigned-url, multipart-upload, event-secrecy) and the R2 real-account smoke stay unchanged and continue to pass byte-identical on the extended fixture. Blueprint README extended with a Hetzner Object Storage sub-section under the provider-choice section; guide extended with a Hetzner sub-section; blueprint CHANGELOG gains a 1.1.0 entry; shelf-wide topics.md sweep updates the object-storage-s3 row from shipped v1.0.0 to shipped v1.1.0 across every blueprint's docs/topics.md per the round-6 admin-console 1.1.0 precedent (PR #169). rcf-lite package version does NOT bump for this follow-up (spec section 8). Repo chain: REQ-140, US-14001 with AC-14001-1, TS-170 with TC-170-hetzner-endpoint-round-trip-and-skipped-shape, FBS-160 (buildOrder 63), CN-500, plus blueprint REQ-101 and blueprint US-28110 as blueprint-owned deltas, minted via rcf define create --id per HQ round-7 follow-up reserved-block ruling 2026-09-08 (adapter block REQ-140..144 / TS-170..174 / FBS-160..164 / CN-500..509). 64FBS-165 H-1 hardening: deploy-hetzner-server v1.0.0 to v1.0.1 patch train; fixes the nine defects the round-7 real-account gate run d-2026-09-08-010 found; makes the shared throwaway-server fixture consume the same rendered cloud-init the real path consumes AC1 buildable notStarted

H-1 patch train against deploy-hetzner-server (blueprint bump 1.0.0 to 1.0.1; every existing contribution id byte-identical) and the shared throwaway-Hetzner-server fixture at packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/hetzner-throwaway-server/. Defect list from projects/blueprint-library/reports/real-account-r7-2026-09-08/README.md CONCERNS: (1) provision.mjs reads camelCase off the hcloud JSON (publicNet.ipv4.ip, datacenter.location.name, serverType.name) but hcloud emits snake_case (public_net, server_type, datacenter.location.name); fix reads s.public_net.ipv4.ip, s.datacenter.location.name, s.server_type.name; (2) provision.mjs expects hetzner/servers/rendered/ci-throwaway.cloud-init.yaml that nothing writes; fix renders inline via src/cloud-init-renderer.mjs before hcloud server create fires; (3) renderer substitutes ssh key NAMES into ssh_authorized_keys; fix resolves each name to its public-key material via hcloud ssh-key describe <name> --output json and inlines the .publicKey text; (4) destroy.mjs and sweep-orphans.mjs pass --output json to delete verbs that reject the flag; fix drops it and the tolerant JSON parser accepts arrays; (5) src/snapshot-verb.mjs calls a non-existent hcloud image create-image; fix shells hcloud server create-image --type snapshot --description <label> <id> and recovers the created snapshot id via hcloud image list --type=snapshot --output json by matching the serverName label; (6) src/ssh-baseline-check.mjs runs ssh immediately after provisionThrowawayServer; fix polls port 22 open plus a trivial ssh true exec, bounded up to 6 minutes, before firing the six baseline checks; (7) the deploy user has no NOPASSWD sudo in the rendered user-data; fix adds a write_files sudoers.d fragment granting NOPASSWD to that user with mode 0440; (9) hetzner/servers/ci-throwaway.json hard-codes sshKeyIds ['rcf-lite-ci']; fix adds an env override RCF_LITE_CI_SSH_KEY_NAME resolved at provision time with the manifest value as default, documented in the fixture README. Defect (8) T-2 and T-3 stub drivers are OUT of scope (H-2 owns them). Also: hcloud-dry-run-mock and the two other T-1 mocked probes gain fixture-side SIMULATE_ switches that alter INPUT only, satisfying the mutation-purity gate row; the mock reads the same rendered cloud-init the real path consumes and asserts an ssh public-key line and a NOPASSWD directive for the deploy user. Report envelopes under .rcf/reports/blueprints/deploy-hetzner-server/ regenerated from the REAL run under Baz one-off approval 2026-09-08 (repo-relative paths only, no secrets). CHANGELOG 1.0.1 entry lists the fixes by defect number. Chain: HQ hardening block H-1 REQ-145..149 / TS-175..179 / FBS-165..169 / CN-510..519 per HQ chain-block ruling 2026-09-08. Base commit origin/main 231bc74.

73FBS-189 Referee-guarantees: verified-invariant gate + merge-state precondition on finalise AC3 buildable notStarted

Gate the two paths that let the 0.27.0 chain say verified without a real finalise run. Writer refuses FBS.executionStatus=verified unless options.allowVerifiedOverride is true; rcf define update exposes --acknowledge-verified-override as the deliberate manual escape; rcf build finalise passes the seam through so its happy path is unchanged. Finalise spawns git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD before the executionStatus write and refuses promotion (exit 4) when the branch is not main / master; --allow-pre-merge is the deliberate opt-out (logged on stdout). Absent a git checkout the check degrades to a warn line. Closes referee-guarantees docs claims C-22 and C-26. w-2026-09-16-dave-013.

194FBS-194 DEFINE slice 1: delta module and freeze record I/O defineDetection AC4 small complete

Ship src/query/delta.js (hashDocument, computeTreeHash, computeDelta) and src/define/freeze-record.js (load, save, validate). Export the delta primitives from src/query/index.js. Cover every AC with unit tests in test/query/delta.test.js and test/define/freeze-record.test.js.

Approach

Pure module with SHA-256 over canonical JSON per proposal 2026-09-22 v3 section 2.1 / 2.2. Canonicalise recurses over the parsed value, sorting object keys and stripping whitespace. Tree hash is SHA-256 over the sorted (id, docHash) pairs. Delta enumerates tree.byId once and classifies each id against the freeze docHashes, appending ledger:<name> entries for the sidecars the caller passes. Freeze record I/O treats a missing file as null; a malformed body raises FreezeRecordError with a coded reason and a named field. The writer validates first so a bad in-memory record never lands on disk.

Acceptance criteria (4)

AC-17201-1, AC-17201-2, AC-17201-3, AC-17201-4

  • test/query/delta.test.js: eleven tests covering AC-17201-1 and AC-17201-2
  • test/define/freeze-record.test.js: nine tests covering AC-17201-3 and AC-17201-4

195FBS-195 DEFINE slice 1: four sidecar ledgers and rcf define ledger CLI defineLedgers AC4 deps1 medium complete

Ship src/define/ledgers.js (load, save, validate, addEntry, resolveEntry, parseBriefFromFile, loadAllLedgers), src/cli/ledger.js (add / resolve / list on every ledger name; renderDecisionsList prints the #241 format), and wire under define in bin/rcf.js and src/cli/help.js. Prove walker invisibility of rcf/define/ with a dedicated test.

Approach

One JSON file per ledger under rcf/define/ (brief-ledger.json, decisions-ledger.json, concern-ledger.json, probe-ledger.json). LEDGER_NAMES is the closed list of accepted names; per-ledger config maps to the filename and array key. Validation is local (no @stravica-ai/rcf-schemas change). loadLedger returns an empty ledger on ENOENT; a malformed file raises LedgerError with a coded reason. addEntry mints ids per ledger and validates the whole body before returning it. The CLI wraps parseArgs, prints per-verb usage from HELP so 'rcf help define ledger' and 'rcf define ledger --help' render the same block, and disposes of ledger-specific flags (--kind, --text, --from, --source, --question, --option, --default, --blocks, --req, --concern, --disposition, --reason, --answer, --finding, --severity). renderDecisionsList prints the numbered #241 format for decisions list. The walker never reads rcf/define/ because loader.subdirFor names its children by kind; a dedicated test seeds four ledger files plus a bug-bait req-999.json under rcf/define/ and asserts no walker error path starts with rcf/define/ and no matching id lands in tree.byId.

196FBS-196 DEFINE slice 2: stage gates D1..D8 pure check functions defineDetection AC10 deps1 medium complete

Ship src/query/gates.js exposing one check function per stage D1..D8 with the section 2.4 shape { stage, gate, state, checks[] }. Blocking stages (D1, D2, D4, D7, D8) enforce the floors listed in proposal section 3.2; warn-with-ack stages (D3, D5, D6) run only the cheap data-backed checks and are acknowledgeable via freeze.gates[<gate>] at the current tree hash. AC class parses off the bracketed prefix on AC description (decision 6); D4 per-class opt-outs read manifest.baselineAcOptOuts[] with baselineKey 'defineD4:failure' or 'defineD4:mustNot' per ADR-4122.

Approach

One file, eight exported functions plus the STAGE_ORDER, STAGE_GATES, STAGE_SHORT_NAMES and INTERFACE_KINDS constants. Every function follows the same shape: decide notApplicable per section 3.2; assemble a checks[] list of { name, ok, over, pass, total, failing }; fold to state, honouring the warn-with-ack acknowledgement window when the stage is D3/D5/D6. Ledger reads use the emptyLedger fallback so an absent ledger contributes no findings. AC class parsing is a static regex over the description string (leading '[failure]' / '[must-not]' / '[happy]' / '[edge]' / '[non-functional]', case-sensitive). Profile parsing is a light presence check on rcf/.identity/profile.md (surface and register markers).

197FBS-197 DEFINE slice 2: computeReadiness compose and rcf define readiness CLI defineDetection AC6 deps1 medium complete

Ship src/query/readiness.js (computeReadiness composing delta + fan-out + gates + coverage + decisions into the section 2.4 object), src/cli/readiness.js (rcf define readiness [--json] [--check <stage>|all]), wire into bin/rcf.js and src/cli/help.js, resolve the slice-1 P3 by correcting loadAllLedgers to omit absent ledger files from the returned bundle.

Approach

Pure composer over TAC-4122's gates. computeImpact is called once per id in changed union added; impacted is the deduplicated union of every impact node id excluding pivots; impactedFbs is the subset { kind === 'fbs' AND actionNeeded === 're-execute' }. Coverage runs tree-wide (strict per-AC) plus once per REQ ancestor of the delta. nextAction picks the first failing stage in D1..D8 order and the first failing check inside it. freezeable is the AND of every stage state being passed / acknowledged / notApplicable. The CLI wraps its producer with runWithAdmissibilityGate; on refuse the wrapper's refusal envelope prints on stderr and the CLI exits 4. Text output follows section 6.2 (tree line, next action, chip line, delta list, failing items). --json emits JSON.stringify(result, null, 2). --check <stage> narrows the output and gates the exit code per AC-17501-5. loadAllLedgers is updated to stat each file first and omit missing ones (P3 resolution).

Acceptance criteria (6)

AC-17501-1, AC-17501-2, AC-17501-3, AC-17501-4, AC-17501-5, AC-17501-6

198FBS-198 DEFINE slice 3: rcf define freeze CLI + freeze-record override + hygiene defineDetection AC8 deps1 medium buildable notStarted

Ship src/cli/freeze.js implementing 'rcf define freeze' as the only freeze-record writer, wire it into bin/rcf.js and src/cli/help.js, update src/define/freeze-record.js so override is a nullable-required field (loader defaults missing keys to null; validator refuses a body without the key), and replace the ' -- ' double-dash in the readiness CLI stage header and the CHANGELOG TODO-regex line with a colon.

Approach

One CLI module composing computeReadiness (REQ-175) and saveFreezeRecord (REQ-172). Ack parsing is a small helper walking --ack and --reason multi-valued arrays in parallel. Ack folding uses the same WARN_WITH_ACK rules gates.js applies at the current tree hash. Counts derivation reuses tree.kindById and parseAcClass; interface counts walk each TAC's interfaces[]. Version reading loads packages/rcf-lite/package.json, src/ruleset/ruleset.json and node_modules/@stravica-ai/rcf-schemas/package.json. --status is a read-only branch that never runs gates. Admissibility refusal is informational per ADR-4124. The freeze-record schema fix requires an override field (nullable): validator throws on missing key, loader defaults missing keys to null on read for backward compatibility, saveFreezeRecord's own validate step catches a caller that forgets to write override.

Acceptance criteria (8)

199FBS-199 DEFINE step 2 (0.29.0) PR A: persona tags on every gate check and two readiness levels (ADR-4126) defineDetection AC23 deps1 medium complete

Ship the compute layer for ADR-4126: CHECK_PERSONA / CHECK_QUESTION maps and persona + question on every stages[].checks[] entry; split skeleton:reqFields into skeleton:reqIntent + skeleton:reqShape and decisions:allAnswered into decisions:wellFormed + decisions:allAnswered; add the new D3 shapes:draftSettled check and the parseInterfaceDraft helper; fold levels (intentComplete, readyToBuild) and personas (productOwner, engineer) on the computeReadiness result; extend deriveNextAction with an optional persona filter; add formatVerdictLines shared by the CLI (PR B) and the Readiness tab (PR C). All additions are strictly additive; the 0.28.4 top-level shape is preserved and rcf define readiness default behaviour / exit codes are unchanged.

Approach

One pass through src/query/gates.js adds the persona + question maps and plumbs them through makeCheck; the two splits are per-REQ / per-entry loops that evaluate every item independently so one failure never masks another; the shapes:draftSettled check parses the leading bracket marker on interface descriptions (whitespace tolerated). src/query/readiness.js folds levels + personas from stages[].checks[] after the eight stage functions run; deriveNextAction gains an optional persona argument; formatVerdictLines builds the two shared verdict strings. The CLI flags (--level, --persona) and the viewer tab land in PRs B and C of the same train and are out of scope here.

200FBS-200 DEFINE step 2 (0.29.0) PR B: --level, --persona and persona-grouped text report on rcf define readiness (ADR-4126) defineDetection AC9 deps1 small complete

Add --level intent|build and --persona productOwner|engineer to rcf define readiness, print the two verdict lines at the top of the text report, regroup blockers into product-owner and engineer sections ordered by the profile.md register, carry _meta.level in the JSON envelope, and wire the exit matrix per spec section 3.2. --persona is a display filter only; --level drives the exit code and --level build is stricter than --check all on unacknowledged warn-with-ack failures. Chain-first: US-17503 and TS-222 land first; TAC-4123 gains the new interfaces and responsibility bump.

Approach

One pass through src/cli/readiness.js parses the two new flags via parseLevelFlag / parsePersonaFlag (shared usage-line shape with --check), passes the resolved level into the JSON envelope's _meta, prints the verdict pair (formatVerdictLines) at the top of the text report, renders a Product owner / Engineer blocker pair ordered by the profile register (PO first by default), and emits the per-stage detail with the persona inside the parenthesis after `over`. --persona X collapses the opposite-persona block to one 'hidden; run without --persona' line and restricts the per-stage detail to matching-persona checks. decideExitCode now folds the --check policy (unchanged), --level intent (4 iff levels.intentComplete.ok === false) and --level build (4 iff levels.readyToBuild.ok === false, with the warn-with-ack warn lines still emitted). src/cli/help.js is unchanged because the per-verb HELP is sourced directly from readiness.js.

Acceptance criteria (9)

AC-17503-1, AC-17503-2, AC-17503-3, AC-17503-4, AC-17503-5, AC-17503-6, AC-17503-7, AC-17503-8, AC-17503-9

  • src/query/readiness.js: parseLevelFlag and parsePersonaFlag helpers exported for the CLI (and the Readiness tab's future test-shared harness)
  • test/cli/readiness.test.js: AC-17503-1 through AC-17503-9 cases, including the parameterised exit matrix

201FBS-201 DEFINE step 2 (0.29.0) PR C: Readiness tab as tab 1, Overview-to-PRD rename, shared pill, findings-list and diff components (REQ-180, REQ-181, TAC-4127, ADR-4127) defineDetection AC10 deps1 medium complete

Land src/view/readiness.js plus src/view/components/{pill,findings-list,diff}.js; wire Readiness as the first tab in html-page.js; rename the Overview button and panel to PRD with no content change; keep the data-tab=overview identifier so existing hash anchors still resolve. The tab renders the computeReadiness result passed in from renderModelToPage (which loads the freeze record, ledgers, test pointers and profile text once per rewalk). Document-level diff only; criterion-level before-and-after is deferred per ADR-4127. Product Map and Requirements markup is unchanged; the shared components are additive in 0.29.0.

Approach

html-page.js: insert the Readiness tab button as the first entry; relabel the Overview button and panel heading to PRD (identifiers preserved); add the inline-script TABS entry 'readiness' as the first value; renderContent receives the readiness result on the model and emits the Readiness tabpanel ahead of the PRD tabpanel. src/view/readiness.js: eleven block builders in spec-section-5 order calling the three shared components; register ordering picked once at the top; blocker ids rendered as hash anchors so the existing resolveHash routine opens the right document tab. src/view/components/*.js: three small, pure modules each exporting the one function the tab calls. src/view/index.js: renderModelToPage loads freeze, ledgers, testPointers and profileText once per walk and attaches the readiness result to the model so the SSE live-update path carries the recomputed object. Tests under test/view/readiness-tab.test.js cover AC-18001-1..7 and AC-18101-1..3; the layout-regression baseline is regenerated as a result of the new DOM.

202FBS-202 DEFINE step 3 PRs 1-2: intake markers, ledger update, resolvedBy grammar (PR 1); computeQuestions, questions verb and MCP tools (PR 2) defineLedgers AC36 deps2 medium buildable notStarted

Carry the ACs for PRs 1 and 2 of the DEFINE step 3 spec (2026-10-01). PR 1: statement-file markers in parseBriefFromFile ([kind] and (source: ...)), the brief add --scan / --no-scan / --findings / --dry-run / --json wiring, the new ledger <name> update <id> subverb, and the resolvedBy closed pointer grammar validated by D2 (title-hit fallback dropped). PR 2: computeQuestions pure compute over readiness per persona; `rcf define questions` verb; three MCP tools (rcf_define_questions, rcf_define_readiness, rcf_define_ledger); the define-intent guidance file and the rcf_define_intent + rcf_define_intake prompts; two new managed-block rules. Chain-first commits landed before the code in each PR. FBS stays notStarted until the CN axis mints Code Nodes against the 36 ACs across PRs 1 and 2 (PR 1 convention; CN axis is a dedicated follow-up). PR 1 tests ride TS-215; PR 2 tests ride TS-226.

Approach

PR 1: parseBriefFromFile parses a leading [kind] and a trailing (source: ...) marker; unknown kind raises LedgerError code 'usage' before any write. updateEntry patches named fields and re-runs validateLedger. parseResolvedBy / isResolvedByGrammar implement the closed pointer grammar. runIntakeScansOnDelta composes the three mechanical scans in src/intake/validate.js over new-plus-existing statements, attributing findings to the statement ids that participate. The CLI brief add wires --scan / --no-scan / --findings / --dry-run / --json; the update subverb lives beside add in src/cli/ledger.js. D2's skeleton:resolvedBy drops the title-hit fallback and refuses a pointer outside the grammar with 'pointer does not resolve'. PR 2: src/query/questions.js exports computeQuestions(readiness, { tree, ledgers, profileText, persona }) folding readiness blockers into questions through a per-check template; src/cli/questions.js registers `rcf define questions` with --json, --persona, --stage, --limit; src/mcp/tools.js adds rcf_define_questions, rcf_define_readiness and rcf_define_ledger (thin wrapper over the ledger handler); guidance/define-intent.md and guidance/elicitation-playbook.md ship the loop content; guidance/manifest.json registers the new slug and the two argument-free prompts rcf_define_intent and rcf_define_intake; guidance/managed/agent-instructions-block.md adds the two new rules.

203FBS-203 Viewer UI refresh build stream: Build/DAG sub-tab, filters, inspector and later tab deltas (US-204 and successor USs) reviewSurface AC7 large inProgress

Single FBS owning the Build/DAG sub-tab acceptance criteria (AC-204-1..7, US-204) that land as the viewer UI refresh PR 6, plus the successor acceptance criteria the same build stream picks up in PRs 7 to 9 (AC-205-*, AC-206-*, AC-18002-*). The stream delivers one chain-first tab delta per PR: DAG (PR 6), tests/traces (PR 7), evaluations (PR 8) and the shared chrome and release prep (PR 9). This FBS stays `inProgress` for the length of the stream so the AC-ownership check on origin/main is green between PRs; successor PRs extend the `acIds` list under this file as their new USs land.

Approach

Build the DAG sub-tab (PR 6) under src/view/build-dag.js with buildDagLayout, renderBuildDag, renderDagInspector and buildDagInspectorPayload; wire html-page.js's renderBuildPanel to call the new renderer in place of the PR 5 placeholder; add wireBuildDag in page-init.js for click-to-highlight, filters, inspector fill from the data-* attribute payload and `#tab=build&sub=dag&entity=` deep links. Inspector payload rides on a `data-rcf-dag-inspector-data` attribute on the inspector shell per the PR 1 contract (no inline <script> body). `currentDagHashExtras` keeps Specs filter keys unknown on the DAG sub-tab so the decision 11 preservation contract holds. applyBuildHash auto-presses Show-unconnected on restoring an unconnected FBS. PR 7 to PR 9 extend the renderer, add their own sub-tab, filter and inspector pieces and append the new ACs to this FBS's `acIds` array; this file is the single owner of the AC coverage for the whole stream so the dogfood tree's `every AC covered by at least one FBS` check stays green at every merge.

Acceptance criteria (7)

AC-204-1, AC-204-2, AC-204-3, AC-204-4, AC-204-5, AC-204-6, AC-204-7

Deliverables

  • packages/rcf-lite/src/view/build-dag.js: buildDagLayout, renderBuildDag, renderDagInspector, buildDagInspectorPayload (pure HTML string + data-attr payload shell)
  • packages/rcf-lite/src/view/html-page.js: renderBuildPanel calls renderBuildDag with the inspector payload argument (PR 5 placeholder removed)
  • packages/rcf-lite/src/view/page-init.js: wireBuildDag (click-to-highlight, filters, inspector fill, hash round-trip, auto-press show-unconnected on restore); currentDagHashExtras preserves non-DAG hash params
  • packages/rcf-lite/src/view/style.css: `.rcf-dag-*` tokens aligned with the Stravica brand palette, both themes
  • packages/rcf-lite/test/view/build-tab.test.js: twelve new unit tests for buildDagLayout (depth columns, closures, critical path, cycle, unconnected lane), renderBuildDag (toolbar, canvas, edges), buildDagInspectorPayload, page-init DAG wiring markers and the AC-204-7 postMessage guard
  • packages/rcf-lite/test/view/fixtures/phase-3-6-static.html: baseline regenerated to include the DAG panel with the data-attr inspector payload shell
  • packages/rcf-lite/rcf/requirements/req-002.json: description amended with the DAG sub-tab coverage
  • packages/rcf-lite/rcf/user-stories/us-204.json: US-204 with AC-204-1..7
  • packages/rcf-lite/rcf/tacs/tac-4131-build-dag-view.json, packages/rcf-lite/rcf/adrs/adr-4133-dag-dependency-depth-layout.json: chain docs

Context

TACs: TAC-4131-build-dag-view

ADRs: ADR-4133-dag-dependency-depth-layout

Show in the DAG
